native_component.scope: Synthetic component comparisons use actual old/local and compacted kernels. They validate exact arithmetic, tails, scratch redzones, inputs and a nonblocking stream; their timings do not establish model performance.

decision: Retain the optional compacted routed schedule in the strict experimental configuration. All three complete frozen requests and captured GB10 boundaries pass, with actual callback TTFT improvements of 2473.8031 / 2482.0551 / 1851.4333 ms for q8192 / q7169 / q8191. Continue structural work: q8192 still takes 77000.9007 ms and neither the retained target nor the absolute 10-second bound is met.
